Ph.D: 
Study of laser-cluster interaction using molecular dynamics modeling, specifically the effect of intense femtosecond pulses on noble gas clusters using classical molecular dynamics.
Post-Doctoral work:
Study of the onset and nature of damage in silicon films using Three-Temperature Model and the effect of different interaction parameters on the damage threshold as a part of the ultrafast electronic dynamics project at Kansai Institute for Photon Science (QST) in Kyoto, Japan.
